Aisha (CSM): Quick sync — we need to lock the QBR deck for Orion and surface 3 things for execs: onboarding gaps, renewal risk indicators, and the enablement ask. Can folks commit to final content by EOD Friday?
Tom (AE): Yes on my end. I'll update the customer health slide with the ARR movement and contract timeline today.
Lucas (RevOps): I can pull the churn / usage cohort graphs. Will drop PNGs in the slides by 3pm.
Marina (SE): I have two technical gaps the Cs team flagged — will add a short remediation plan slide. Also can do a 10min demo clip if you want.
Aisha (CSM): Perfect. Outline I'm thinking (short):
```
1) One-line exec summary + ask
2) Health snapshot (usage, NPS, pilot success metric)
3) Onboarding gaps & remediation owner + ETA
4) Renewal signal + risks (contacts, decision timeline)
5) Enablement ask: 1 workshop + playbook + featured metric
6) Appendix: logs, runbook, demo clip
```
Tom (AE): For the exec ask — propose: 1) approve 2-week funded enablement workshop, 2) sign-off on a dedicated SE hour block for migration. Short bullets only.
Lucas (RevOps): @Aisha can you confirm the 'decision timeline' date? I have two different dates in SFDC.
Aisha (CSM): Customer expects decision by 2026-04-15 per last call. I'll reconcile with SFDC and update.
Marina (SE): For remediation owners — propose we assign: Marina for infra fixes, Tom for PO alignment, Aisha for enablement comms.
Jared (Customer): Quick note from our side — Execs want to see a concrete ROI metric from the pilot (time-to-value). If you can show example before/after numbers that's huge.
Aisha (CSM): Good call Jared — Lucas can you surface the pilot time-to-value stat?
Lucas (RevOps): I'll compute TTV (pre/post mean) and add a 2-line callout.
Tom (AE): I'm adding a one-slide 'ask' with the workshop outline + expected outcomes. Will keep it to 3 bullets.
Aisha (CSM): Who can run the dry run on Monday (short, 20m) with exec attendees list? Need to confirm availability.
Marina (SE): I can do Monday morning. Prefer 9:30 PT.
Tom (AE): I can do 9:30 PT as well.
Lucas (RevOps): I'll be in a meeting earlier but can join recording and send notes if needed.
Aisha (CSM): OK locking dry run Mon 9:30 PT. @deckbot can you schedule the meeting and attach the deck?
deckbot: meeting created — "Orion QBR dry run" Mon 2026-04-06 09:30 PT. Deck placeholder: https://drive.redwood/example-orion-qbr-v3.pptx
Aisha (CSM): Action items summary (I'll post to the board):
- Tom: final exec ask slide + onboarding owner bullet (due Fri EOD)
- Lucas: cohort graphs + TTV stat (due Fri 3pm)
- Marina: remediation slide + demo clip (due Fri EOD)
- Aisha: reconcile SFDC decision date + compile slides (due Fri 6pm)
- All: review dry run slide notes before Mon 9:30
Tom (AE): noted. Will add a single slide with costs/benefits.
Lucas (RevOps): noted. Will upload images to the deck and ping when done.
Marina (SE): I'll upload demo clip link and short runbook snippet.
Aisha (CSM): FYI renewal risk tier: MEDIUM (customer has exec interest but budget constraint). We'll call this out in the readout.
Jared (Customer): Thanks everyone — appreciate keeping the ROI callout front-and-center. We'll confirm two execs for dry run invite.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post the final deck link + action board tomorrow morning. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup:
